meta.project: Ohioans HomeHealth Care - Referral Bot (Careport) migration to new CareFlo platform
meta.revision: r2 2026-11-23: masters added; Payer Portal BRD not available

source_authority.rule: Wins over the document history notes
Define data structure and values; BRD defines the rules. Where a master has no column for a BRD rule, the rule is blocked, not dropped.
Used only when the body does not cover the change
Would win over BRD prose by default, but not supplied (MIS-001)

in_scope: BRD sections 5.1-5.31 for the Careport referral portal
Payer portal login and outcome routing

excluded_flows.reason: In the separate Payer Portal BRD

requirements.title: Log in to referral portals
requirements.description: CareFlo logs in to the referral portals (Careport in scope for this BRD) before monitoring.

requirements.title: Monitor new referrals continuously
requirements.description: CareFlo monitors the referral portal for new referral records continuously (intake coordinators check referrals 24 hours; peak 11am-4pm EST).

requirements.title: Fetch referral data from portal screen
requirements.description: CareFlo fetches referral data from the referral portal screen; for portals other than Careport go directly to step 5.1.6 (download documents).

requirements.title: Masked Careport referral handling
requirements.description: If a Careport referral is masked: send a 'Masked Referral' alert, set Careport Response 'Decision Pending Review' with Comment 'Please unmask.', keep monitoring the referral until it is unmasked, then continue at step 5.1.6.

requirements.title: Non 'Not Placed' status goes to manual
requirements.description: If the referral record status in Careport New Referral tab is other than 'Not Placed' (Placed Here or Placed Elsewhere), notify the Admission team and flag the record for manual processing.

requirements.title: Same response for all branch sites
requirements.description: When the referral source sends a multi-branch request, update the same Response and Comment for all sites, for every accept and decline response.

requirements.title: Medicare in-area patient on Approval Required list
requirements.description: If Zip and Primary Insurance are available on the portal screen, the insurance is Medicare, the zip is in the Service Area (zip-only match) and the patient is on the Approval Required List: set Intake Review Flag1 = TRUE and generate an Intake Review Ask. If the Ask decision is Accept: accept the referral (Response 'Yes, Willing to accept patient', Comment 'Hello, we are happy to accept! If we see any issues, we will reach out! Can you confirm we are agency of choice?'), create the chart, generate a Mandatory EMR Ask if mandatory info is missing, and send the chart creation alert. If Decline: decline the referral. [r2] Approval Required List master supplied.

requirements.title: Medicare in-area patient auto-accepted without PDF extraction
requirements.description: If Zip and Primary Insurance are available on the portal screen, the insurance is Medicare, the zip is in the Service Area (zip-only match) and the patient is NOT on the Approval Required List: accept the referral (same accept Response/Comment as 5.1.7) and create the chart without downloading/extracting referral documents; generate a Mandatory EMR Ask if mandatory info is missing; send the chart creation alert.

requirements.title: Medicare out-of-area decline
requirements.description: If Zip and Primary Insurance are available on the portal screen, the insurance is Medicare and the zip is NOT in the Service Area (zip-only match): decline with Response 'No, unable to accept patient', Response Reason 'Other (See comments)', Comment 'Thank you for thinking of us, however this patient is outside our service area.' and send the Out of Service Area decline alert.

ids: Alert: Out of Service area decline

requirements.title: Non-Medicare or missing data goes to full path
requirements.description: If Zip and Primary Insurance are available but the insurance is NOT Medicare, or Zip/Primary Insurance are NOT available on the portal screen, continue to document download and extraction (step 5.1.11 onward).

requirements.title: Extract remaining details from referral PDFs
requirements.description: Download referral documents from the referral portal and extract remaining referral details from the referral PDFs (digital or scanned).

requirements.title: Basic Info Missing Ask
requirements.description: If Patient name or DOB is missing after screen and PDF extraction, generate a Basic Info Missing Ask.

requirements.title: Approval Required list check (flag 2)
requirements.description: Check whether the patient is on the Approval Required List. If yes set Intake Review Flag2 = TRUE. In both cases continue to step 5.4 (Kantime report lookup by Patient name and DOB). [r2] Source = Approval Required List master (First Name, Last Name, Date of Birth, EMR MRN, Patient ID, Status); match on name + DOB where Status = ACTIVE.

requirements.title: Capture 25 referral fields from Careport
requirements.description: Capture the 25 data items listed in section 5.2 (First/Last name, DOB, Sex at Birth, Facility/Sending Organization, Primary Plan Description, SSN, Primary Plan Number, Address, County, Zip, Primary Care Physician, Race, Marital status, Religion, Patient Phone, Emergency Contacts 1 and 2, Referral ID, Facility Contact, Home Health Order, Discharge Note/Projected Discharge Date, Gender Identity, Referral Source as Facility/Physician, ACO Affiliation (Dashboard > Attributions), Secondary Plan Description and Number) from the Careport tabs named in the table; items 12-14 come from the Referral PDF.

requirements.title: Extract Home Health Order (services)
requirements.description: Extract patient services (Home Health Order) from Careport Referral Comments and from referral PDF document types H&P, CRF, F2F, Continuation of Care, DC Order, AVS and Referral.

requirements.title: Classify referral source as Facility or Physician
requirements.description: Referral Source is FACILITY if Careport Admission Information has Location and/or Patient Class and/or Patient Type (Inpatient/Out Patient); otherwise PHYSICIAN.

requirements.title: Discharge note / SOC date drives Discharging status
requirements.description: Extract Discharge Note from Referral Comments and Projected Discharge Date from Admission Information. If the discharge note has a Start of Care / SOC date, Kantime Intake Status is Discharging.

requirements.title: Combine Careport documents into one PDF
requirements.description: In Careport click Combine Documents > Select All, enter the patient's first name as File Name, click Combine Referral Documents; wait while status is Pending until Completed (takes a couple of minutes); open the combined document (last in list) and save as PDF named '<First name Last name> Intake <MMDDYY>' on SharePoint.

requirements.title: Print referral when no documents
requirements.description: If there are no documents, print the referral (Print icon) and save the PDF on SharePoint named '<First name Last name> Intake <MMDDYY>'.

requirements.title: Kantime per-document upload naming
requirements.description: Upload each Careport document separately to Kantime named '<First name initial(s) and Last name> <Document name in Careport> <MMDDYY>'; if Careport has duplicate document names, suffix '1/2/3'.

requirements.title: Download Referral Management-Intake list 4x daily
requirements.description: Download Kantime Reports > Custom Reports > Referral management Intake list with Intake Date From = 01/01/2020 at 7am, 12pm, 5pm and 10pm EST. It provides patients in Active, Transfer, Discharge, PSOC, Hold and Non-Admit status.

requirements.title: Download Client Intake list every 30 minutes
requirements.description: Download Kantime Referral > Client Intake list every 30 minutes with default filters unchanged (all 4 locations; Admit status Intake and Conditionally Accepted).

requirements.title: Route by Kantime report match
requirements.description: Look up the patient by Patient name and DOB. Found in Referral Management-Intake list: route by status (5.6-5.11). Found in Client Intake list: go to 5.5. Found in both: process per Referral Management-Intake status. Found in neither: treat as new patient.

requirements.title: Client Intake list / Intake status handling
requirements.description: Patient in Client Intake list (or Intake status in RM-Intake list, 5.6): if Intake Review Flag2 = TRUE generate Intake Review Ask (Accept -> continue; Decline -> decline). Otherwise, or on Accept: (1) accept in Careport with Comment 'Hello! Thank you for the referral. We can accept the patient as we were tracking the patient prior.'; (2) in Kantime Referral > Add New Intake search by Location, Line of Business, First/Last name, DOB with DOB match, open the patient, upload documents to the Intake chart; (3) email intake@ohioanshhc.com with the combined PDF, Subject 'Referral ID- <Patient First Last name> - DOB- Intake and Conditionally accepted status', Body 'The patient is in Intake and Conditionally accepted state in Kantime. Please update patient chart manually. Thankyou Referral Bot'.

requirements.title: Active / Recert Due / EOE handling
requirements.description: Status Active/Recert Due/EOE: Approval-Required Ask handling as 5.5. Otherwise accept with Comment 'Hello! Thank you for the referral and we are able to accept back! This patient is currently on services with us! Please keep us posted on updates 😊'; upload documents in Kantime Documents > Add New with Category 'Resumption packet', Folder 'Resumption'; email To hospitalization@ohioanshhc.com, Intake team and Team email, Cc Marketer email, combined PDF attached, Subject 'Referral ID- <Patient First Last name> - DOB- Active Status- Document uploaded in Kantime', body naming the facility and listing Careport-vs-Kantime mismatches (address+zip, primary plan name, Policy ID/MBI, Home Health Order/discipline).

requirements.title: Transfer / On Hold handling
requirements.description: Status Transfer/On Hold: same as Active (5.7) including Resumption upload, except email has no Cc, Subject 'Referral ID- <Patient First Last name> - DOB- Transfer Status-- Document uploaded in Kantime', and the mismatch section is omitted ('Email body will be blank if nothing mismatched').

requirements.title: Compare Careport vs Kantime for mismatches
requirements.description: For Active and Transfer/On Hold emails, compare Careport against Kantime for: patient address and zip, primary payer plan name, Policy ID/MBI, Home Health Order/discipline; list only differing items in the email.

requirements.title: PSOC handling
requirements.description: Status PSOC: Approval-Required Ask handling as 5.5. Otherwise accept with Comment 'Hello! Thank you for the referral, we were planning a SOC with the patient prior to returning back to the hospital! We would be happy to accept back! 😊'; email intake@ohioanshhc.com Cc Marketer, combined PDF, Subject 'Referral ID- <Patient First Last name> - DOB- PSOC status', Body 'The patient is in PSOC state in Kantime. Please update patient chart manually. Thankyou Referral Bot'. No Kantime upload.

requirements.title: Do not decline/flag active-type statuses
requirements.description: Do not decline or manual-flag referrals when Kantime status is Active / Transfer / PSOC / EOE / Recert Due / On Hold (except via an Approval Required Ask decision).

requirements.title: Mandatory EMR Ask for missing payer/policy
requirements.description: For new or Discharge/Non Admit/Inactive patients, if Plan Description/Payor and Policy ID are not available, generate a Mandatory EMR Ask to get them.

requirements.title: Medicare: missing address Ask
requirements.description: If payer = Medicare and patient address is not available, generate a Mandatory EMR Ask for the address.

requirements.title: Medicare PO Box address: accept and ask for physical address
requirements.description: If payer = Medicare and the address is a PO Box: accept with Comment 'Hello, we are happy to accept! If we see any issues, we will reach out! Can you confirm we are agency of choice? Also, please provide physical Address😊', proceed to chart creation (Mandatory EMR Ask if info missing) and send chart creation alert.

requirements.title: Medicare physical address in-area accept
requirements.description: If payer = Medicare, physical address (no PO Box) and zip in Service Area (zip-only match): accept (standard accept comment), chart creation, Mandatory EMR Ask if needed, chart creation alert.

requirements.title: Medicare physical address out-of-area decline
requirements.description: If payer = Medicare, physical address (no PO Box) and zip NOT in Service Area (zip-only match): decline with the out-of-service-area Response/Comment and send Out of Service area decline alert.

ids: Alert: Out of Service area decline

requirements.title: Medicare PPS plans auto-acceptance
requirements.description: Medicare PPS plans are auto-accepted (post go-live change, Doc History v1.14/v1.16); the PPS-specific detail is not present in v1.25 body text beyond 5.10.

requirements.title: Non-Medicare: missing or PO Box address Ask
requirements.description: If payer = non-Medicare and patient address is not available or is a PO Box, generate a Mandatory EMR Ask to get the patient address.

requirements.title: Non-Medicare zip+county service area check
requirements.description: For non-Medicare: if Zip with County is NOT in the Service Area, decline (out-of-service-area Response/Comment) and send Out of Service area decline alert; if found, continue to the paediatric check (5.13).

ids: Alert: Out of Service area decline

requirements.title: Get county from patient address
requirements.description: Get Zip, County and State using the patient address (entered without zip) from a county lookup service; check county lines; match Zip to Service Area sheet column A and '<County> <State code>' to column B.
technology_hints: Google APIs or Randymajors.org (subject to feasibility)

requirements.title: County API no value: zip-only fallback
requirements.description: If the county API returns no county for a non-Medicare referral, bypass county validation and perform the service area check by ZIP only, without generating a Basic Missing Information Ask for county.

requirements.title: PO Box address flags manual + notification
requirements.description: Address consisting of a PO Box is flagged to manual with notification (post go-live change 12.6), except the Medicare PO Box auto-accept path (5.10.3).

requirements.title: Paediatric patient without paediatric plan: decline
requirements.description: If the patient is paediatric and the Primary plan is NOT a Paediatric Plan (Purple): decline with Response 'Decline', Reason 'Payer Not Accepted', Comment 'Thank you for thinking of us, however we do not take this plan.'; send 'Paediatric patient but not paediatric plan' decline alert; no further CareFlo action.

ids: Alert: Paediatric patient but not paediatric plan decline

requirements.title: Paediatric plan + exception keyword -> review
requirements.description: If paediatric patient with Paediatric Plan (Purple) and an exception keyword is found: set Intake Review Flag6 = TRUE and generate an Intake Review Ask (when any intake review flag is set). Accept -> accept, Paediatric chart creation, Mandatory EMR Ask if needed, chart creation alert. Decline -> decline as per Ask response.

requirements.title: Paediatric plan, no keyword: auto accept
requirements.description: If paediatric patient with Paediatric Plan (Purple) and no exception keyword: accept (standard accept comment), create Paediatric chart (Line of Business Paediatric Skilled), Mandatory EMR Ask if needed, chart creation alert.

requirements.title: Adult with paediatric plan: decline
requirements.description: If adult patient (above 18) and Primary plan is a Paediatric Plan (Purple): decline (Response 'Decline', Reason 'Payer Not Accepted', Comment 'Thank you for thinking of us, however we do not take this plan.'), send 'Adult patient with paediatric plan' decline alert, no further action. Otherwise continue to exception keyword check (5.15).

ids: Alert: Adult patient with paediatric plan decline

requirements.title: Age boundary for paediatric vs adult
requirements.description: Age is calculated from DOB in completed years on the processing date; age < 18 is paediatric, age >= 18 is adult.

requirements.title: Read exception keyword list daily
requirements.description: Read the exception keyword list from the Exception Keywords Master (65 keywords, Action = ASK for all, scoped by Line of Business) at least daily; the list is user-maintained and may grow. [r2] Replaces 'column L of Service Area sheet'.

requirements.title: Keyword search in comments and PDFs
requirements.description: Search Careport Referral Comments and referral PDFs of type H&P (mainly), CRF, F2F, Continuation of Care, DC Order, AVS and Referral for any exception list item (e.g. 'Infusion'). If found set Intake Review Flag6 = TRUE. Continue to 5.16 in either case. [r2] Keywords include short tokens (ALS, AMA, MS, MAG, C9, IVF, PEG, DNR) and overlapping ones (STAGE I / STAGE II), so matching must be whole-word.

requirements.title: Dummy payor in insurance master: decline
requirements.description: If the Payor is found in the payor mapping file as Dummy: decline with Response 'No, unable to accept patient', Reason 'Other (See comments)', Comment 'Thank you for thinking of us, however we do not accept this insurance plan in this patient’s area.' and send 'Payor found as Dummy in Insurance master' decline alert.

ids: Alert: Payor found as Dummy decline

requirements.title: Payor found (non-dummy): continue to UHC/Humana check
requirements.description: If the Payor is found in the payor mapping file and is not Dummy, continue to 5.17.

requirements.title: Payor not found: identifier match path
requirements.description: If the Payor is not found in the payor mapping file, go to the Policy ID identifier match path (section 5.30).

requirements.title: Define Humana and UHC plan descriptions
requirements.description: Humana plan descriptions = Insurance plan master rows with Payer contract = Red and Payer name on Portal = Humana. UHC plan descriptions = rows with Payer contract = Red and Payer Portal = United Healthcare. Found -> 5.18; not found -> 5.19.

requirements.title: No UHC/Humana zip limitation decline
requirements.description: For New/Inactive/Non Admit/Discharged patients: if the patient zip's Service Area column H 'Limitation' is 'NO UHC' or 'No UHC/HUMANA/Devoted' and the plan is a Humana or UHC plan description, decline with Comment 'Thank you for thinking of us, however we are not accepting this insurance in this area at this time.' (Response 'No, unable to accept patient', Reason 'Other (See comments)'), send No UHC/Humana Plan decline alert, and create a Non-Admit chart with reason 'Census at maximum capacity'. Otherwise continue to 5.19.

requirements.title: Agency appropriate plan check
requirements.description: The patient's Agency Location (Service Area sheet column G) must be in the plan's Associated Agencies (Insurance sheet column F). If yes continue to 5.20; if not decline with Comment 'Thank you for thinking of us, however we do not accept this insurance plan in this patient’s area.' and send 'Not an Agency appropriate plan' decline alert.

ids: Alert: Not an Agency appropriate plan decline

requirements.title: Staffing availability per order
requirements.description: For each Home Health Order (discipline) check staffing is available ('x') for the patient's zip+county in the Service Area mapping sheet.

requirements.title: Census at maximum capacity per payer colour
requirements.description: For each order, if the Service Area sheet lists the primary payer's contract colour (Red and/or Yellow) for that order type, the census is at maximum capacity for that payer type and that order cannot be accepted.

requirements.title: Decline only when no order can be accepted
requirements.description: If no patient order (of 1, 2 or 3 orders) can be accepted due to staffing or census, decline with Comment 'Thank you for thinking of us however at this time we have met our census for this payor' (Response 'No, unable to accept patient', Reason 'Other (See comments)'), send 'Met our Census for this payer' decline alert and update CareFlo. If at least one order can be accepted, continue to 5.21 and update CareFlo.

ids: Alert: Met our Census for this payer decline

requirements.title: Census decline creates Non-Admit chart
requirements.description: If declined due to census at maximum capacity, create a Non-Admit chart with Reason For Non-Admit 'Census at maximum capacity'.

requirements.title: Non-Admit chart creation steps
requirements.description: Kantime Referral > Add New Intake; enter Location, Line of Business, First/Last name, DOB with DOB match; Check Duplicate; if patient listed use 3 dots > Readmit, else Admit as New; update General and Payor Source & Eligibility tabs; upload client documents; click Non-Admit, set Reason For Non-Admit, Save.

requirements.title: Restricted facility check applicability
requirements.description: Applies to new patients only (not Active/PSOC/Transfer/Discharge/Discharge-approval-required), to Facility referrals only (not Physician), on any referral portal, and only when the plan's Payer contract colour is Red or Yellow (not Green).

requirements.title: Restricted facility colour match decline
requirements.description: If the referral facility is in the Restricted Facility sheet and the plan's Payer contract colour equals a colour listed for that facility (Red only, Yellow only, or both): decline with Response 'Decline', Reason 'Payer Referrals/ Requests at Capacity', Comment 'Thank you for thinking of us, however we are at our census maximum for this payor.', send 'Referral source exception' decline alert, create Non-Admit chart with reason 'Referral Source Management'. Otherwise continue to payer eligibility. [r2] Restricted Facility master columns: Facility Name, Careport Location, Payer Contract Color ('RED, YELLOW' or 'RED'), Active.

requirements.title: Re-read Restricted Facility sheet
requirements.description: The intake team may update the Facility Restrictions sheet at 6am and 2pm daily; the bot must use the current version.

requirements.title: ProMedica location matching
requirements.description: If Careport sending organization contains 'ProMedica', match the referral Location against column D (format 'Location: PTH', e.g. PTH_F, PTH_F_REHI, PTH, PTH_WWREHI, PTH_WWNS); on match select the corresponding Marketer Email ID and Kantime Facility (column E). [r2] Master has no ProMedica location rows (PTH, PTH_F...); only 'PROMEDICA TOLEDO HOSPITAL' with blank location.

requirements.title: Bon Secours Mercy Health location matching
requirements.description: If sending organization is BonSecoursMercyHealthInc: match referral Location to column D (format 'Location: STVZVPB', partial matches allowed - extra letters/numerics handled); if no location match, match the Facility field to column D. On match select Marketer Email ID and Kantime Facility. Rows with column A 'Bon Secours Mercy Health, Inc.' and a Careport Location in column B are restricted facilities. [r2] Master has no Bon Secours Mercy Health location rows.

requirements.title: Log in to identified payer portal
requirements.description: If CareFlo identified the payer portal from the Payor Plan Master, log in. If the portal is not accessible set Intake Review Flag7 = TRUE (Payor portal not accessible). If not identified go to 5.30.
technology_hints: 8 payer portals: Ability, UHC, Availity, Priority Health, Ohio Medicaid, Golden Rule, UMR, Mi MCD

requirements.title: Patient not found in payer portal
requirements.description: If login succeeds but the patient is not found, set Intake Review Flag8 = TRUE (Patient not found in payor portal).

requirements.title: Primary payer eligibility per Payer Portal BRD
requirements.description: If the patient is found, perform primary payer eligibility check on the portal as specified in the separate Payer Portal BRD. [r2] Deferred: Payer Portal BRD not available (user, 2026-11-23).

requirements.title: Eligible: accept and create/readmit chart
requirements.description: If primary payer is active and eligible: accept with Comment 'Yes! We would be happy to accept.' and proceed to Readmit (5.23) for Discharged/Inactive/Non-Admit patients or New chart creation (5.24).

requirements.title: Inactive payer -> review flag
requirements.description: If the primary payer (Medicare or non-Medicare) is inactive, set Intake Review Flag8 = TRUE (Primary payor found Inactive in Payor portal).

requirements.title: Not eligible: decline, no chart
requirements.description: If the primary payer is not eligible: decline with Comment 'Thank you for thinking of us, however we do not accept this insurance plan.' (Response 'No, unable to accept patient', Reason 'Other (See comments)') and do not create a Kantime chart.

requirements.title: Intake Review Ask when any flag set
requirements.description: When any Intake Review Flag (1, 2, 6, 7, 8) is TRUE generate an Intake Review Ask; Accept continues the normal path, Decline declines the referral at the portal with no further CareFlo action.

requirements.title: Readmit: APPROVAL REQUIRED client alert
requirements.description: For Discharged status, if Kantime Client Alert shows APPROVAL REQUIRED, send an alert 'Discharge/Non Admit/Inactive patient with Kantime Approval Required' and process manually.

requirements.title: Readmit chart steps
requirements.description: Otherwise: Referral > Add New Intake with Location, Line of Business, First/Last name, DOB (DOB match); 3 dots > Readmit; change Location per Service Area sheet (zip+county) and payer per Insurance sheet; Admit; OK; overwrite all sections with new information per 5.25.

requirements.title: Readmit when duplicate check finds Non-Admit
requirements.description: During new patient creation, if the duplicate check shows the latest admit status as 'Non-Admit', readmit the patient instead of creating new.

requirements.title: Location from service area; Monroe override
requirements.description: Location from Service Area sheet by zip+county; if Kantime Payer is one of 'Blue Cross Blue Shield of MI', 'Medicare Plus Blue', 'Blue Care Network', 'BCN ADVANTAGE', Location = 'Ohioans HHC - Monroe'.

source_ref.section: 5.24 New Intake table row 1; Doc History v1.12

requirements.title: Line of Business by age
requirements.description: Line of Business: Adult Skilled for adults, Paediatric Skilled for paediatric patients.

requirements.title: Patient name camel case
requirements.description: Enter patient name as Last name, First name in camel case; DOB from Careport.

requirements.title: Kantime payer from insurance sheet
requirements.description: Payer = Kantime payer name from the Insurance mapping sheet for the Primary Plan Description; if the plan description appears in more than one row, use Policy ID identifier validation (5.30) to choose.

requirements.title: Patient information section
requirements.description: Set Gender, Gender Identity; MBI = Policy ID when plan is Medicare (Row 2); Intake Status = '3- Discharging' if Projected Discharge Date is today or discharge note has SOC date, else '2- Coordination'; Team from Service Area sheet (zip+county).

requirements.title: Non-Medicare Insurance ID
requirements.description: For non-Medicare (not Row 2) plans, Payor Source and Eligibility > Edit > Insurance ID = Policy ID, Save.

requirements.title: Secondary Medicare payer
requirements.description: If secondary payer is Medicare (Row 2) in Availity, add Secondary Payer with name and Insurance ID (Policy ID) from the referral portal.

requirements.title: Referral source section
requirements.description: Facility referral: radio Facility, Referral Facility = Referral Source mapping column G for Careport facility/sending org in column F, else dummy 'Ohioans HomeHealth Care' (Admission Source 'Hospital'); Facility Contact from Careport (add it if not in dropdown); Admission Source from referral source sheet. Physician referral: radio Physician (PCP). Referring Physician = PCP if found, else leave blank. Never enter Attending Physician.

requirements.title: Address from payer portal
requirements.description: Always update the Kantime address with the payer portal address.

requirements.title: Other info, emergency contact, ACO
requirements.description: Marital Status; Religion (skip if no valid option); Place of Service = Patient's Home/Residence; Emergency Contact (skip if the specified popup appears); ACO Affiliation from Attributions (skip if missing).

requirements.title: Upload referral and payer documents
requirements.description: Upload referral documents: Category 'Referral Packet', Folder 'Referral'. Upload payer documents from SharePoint: Category 'Eligibility', Folder 'Eligibility'.

requirements.title: Eligibility title by plan type
requirements.description: In Payer source and eligibility > Edit > pencil: select Commercial AA if Insurance master Commercial = Yes; Medicaid AA if Payer Portal is Ohio Medicaid or Mi MCD; Medicare AA if Medicare = Yes. Applies to new and readmit charts.

requirements.title: Commercial notes: coverage, deductible, OOP
requirements.description: For Commercial AA, write notes with Coverage {Project %}, Deductible and Out of Pocket (max/remaining) and Visit Limit (Availity only) from Availity, Ability, UHC, UMR or Cigna; for UMR remaining = max minus total met. Medicaid/Medicare AA notes use the template unchanged. [r2] Deferred: Payer Portal BRD not available (user, 2026-11-23).

requirements.title: Effective period and eligibility status
requirements.description: Effective start date = current date; Edit Eligibility Status = Eligible, Verified on = current date, Verified by = 'Edge, Automation'; upload portal eligibility documents (Folder Eligibility) and set Eligibility radio; Save.

requirements.title: Team (CC1) update
requirements.description: Assign and Initial Schedule: CC1 from Referral Source mapping sheet CC1 column by referring facility/physician; dummy facility -> TEAM 2.

requirements.title: Marketer name and email
requirements.description: Marketer = Sales Person First/Last Name (columns H, I) for Facility (column F) in Referral Source sheet; email in column K; if name contains 'HOUSE' there is no marketer - omit from email.

requirements.title: Team email ID
requirements.description: Team email = Admission DL column for referring facility/physician; dummy facility -> Team 2 email.

requirements.title: Apply intake team decline from CareFlo
requirements.description: When the Intake team declines through CareFlo, decline in the portal with the CareFlo comment (column A; for EPIC portal remove 'Thank you for thinking of us however'), Careport Response Reason per the 8-row mapping table, and create a Non-Admit chart with the mapped Kantime Non-Admit reason (column B). Applies to all referral portals.

requirements.title: Plan in one row: agency match
requirements.description: Plan description in exactly one Insurance Master row: use it if its agency matches the patient's location; else decline (not agency appropriate comment) and send 'Not an Agency appropriate plan' alert.

ids: Alert: Not an Agency appropriate plan decline

requirements.title: Plan in many rows: agency then identifier
requirements.description: Plan description in more than one row: keep rows matching the patient's agency location (none -> decline, not agency appropriate); then match Policy ID to the Identifier column; one match -> use it; two or more -> first matching row; none/blank -> Intake Review Flag8 'Identifier not matched so Insurance not run' + Intake Review Ask.

requirements.title: Plan not in master: identifier search by agency
requirements.description: Plan description not in Insurance Master: get agency from zip, filter Insurance Master by Associated agency, match Policy ID to identifiers; first matching row wins; none -> Flag8 + Intake Review Ask.

requirements.title: Identifier Ask outcomes
requirements.description: Ask = Decline: decline at portal, no further action. Ask = Accept: accept, generate Mandatory EMR Ask if EMR fields missing, then new chart (5.24) or readmit, and upload referral and payer documents.

requirements.title: Identifier rule = address state + prefix
requirements.description: Plan identification needs both the patient address state rule and the Policy ID prefix rule; if either fails, notify the Admission team / flag for manual and update CareFlo. The prefix list is configurable and must accept new prefixes without code change.

requirements.title: Email for manual processing when identifier missing
requirements.description: If the identifier is not listed in the insurance master, send an email request for manual processing.

requirements.title: Insurance best match
requirements.description: Use an insurance best-match to identify insurance (v1.23 enhancement 13.3); the algorithm is not described in v1.25.

requirements.title: 'Interested' action in CareFlo
requirements.description: Add 'Interested' to the CareFlo Select Action dropdown with a Comment; the bot then selects 'Interested, but need more information' in Careport with the same comment, then creates the patient chart (Paediatric Skilled if under 18).

requirements.title: Decline by referral source after census check
requirements.description: Rule for declining the referral based on referral source after the census check (v1.22/v1.23 enhancement 13.2) - implemented as the Restricted Facility check (5.21).

requirements.title: Log all actions to CareFlo DB
requirements.description: Log every referral's details, decisions, Asks, Alerts and processing status in the CareFlo app database ('Update CareFlo app').

requirements.title: Respond within 1 hour; speed matters
requirements.description: Referrals must be answered within 1 hour (current SLA); portals are first-come first-served, so speed is critical (Medicare bypass exists for this reason).

requirements.title: Volume 60-90 per day
requirements.description: Handle 60-90 referrals/day (1,500/month); Careport about 30-40/day; peak 11am-4pm EST.

requirements.title: Applications and access
requirements.description: Web apps on public URLs in Chrome: Kantime, Careport, Ability, UHC, Availity, Priority Health, Ohio Medicaid, Golden Rule, UMR, Mi MCD, Randymajors.org. Password reset required for Kantime, Careport, Ability, UHC. Email authentication noted. Only Kantime has UAT.
technology_hints: No UAT for Careport or payer portals - testing in production

requirements.title: Other referral portals' UI
requirements.description: Screen sequences for AIDIN, Ensocare, Worldview, TriHealth, Christ, Trinity, Faxage, Jotform etc. are not described; their UI automation is outside this BRD.

requirements.title: Coordination team work
requirements.description: The Coordination team's work (case manager and patient follow-up, moving patient to client) is marked 'Not for Automation'.

requirements.title: Normalise master text before matching
requirements.description: Before matching, trim, uppercase and replace non-breaking spaces (found in Restricted Facility names, e.g. 'MEDINA\u00a0HOSPITAL') with normal spaces in all master and referral values.

requirements.title: Use only Active master rows
requirements.description: Ignore rows where Active / Facility Active = false in the Restricted Facility and Facility masters.

source_ref.section: restricted_facility_master col D; facility_master col P

requirements.title: Treat payor portal 'NULL' as not identified
requirements.description: Payor Mapping rows with Payor Portal 'NULL' (19 rows) or blank are treated as payer portal not identified (section 5.30 path).

requirements.title: Handle multi-portal values
requirements.description: Payor Portal may list two portals ('ABILITY, AVAILITY' 559 rows; 'AVAILITY, ABILITY' 43 rows). The bot tries them in the order listed until the patient is found.

requirements.title: Keyword scope by Line of Business
requirements.description: Apply an exception keyword only when its Line of Business matches the referral (Home Health for this process).

requirements.title: Startup master data checks
requirements.description: At start and on each reload, check masters for: blank required columns, duplicate rows, future DOBs, unparseable values; log and alert the Intake team instead of failing silently.

assumptions.statement: RESOLVED r2: Approval Required List is a master (First Name, Last Name, DOB, EMR MRN, Patient ID, Status). Match on normalised name + DOB, Status = ACTIVE.
assumptions.reason: BRD uses it but never defines its source.

assumptions.statement: Paediatric = under 18 completed years; 18 and above = adult.
assumptions.if_wrong: 18-year-olds get the wrong plan rule and Line of Business.

assumptions.statement: 'Medicare' means the Insurance master Medicare column = Yes (Row 2 plan / MBI).
assumptions.reason: Not defined for the screen-level check.
assumptions.if_wrong: Wrong referrals take the bypass path.

assumptions.statement: Asks and Alerts are raised in the CareFlo app and answered there by the intake team.
Intake Review Flags 3, 4 and 5 are not used in this process.
The census rule generalises to any number of orders: decline only if no order can be accepted.
Keyword matching is case-insensitive whole-word/phrase on normalised text (needed: ALS, MS, MAG, C9 would otherwise match inside other words; STAGE I would match STAGE II).
Mercy partial match = normalised 'contains' match after removing spaces/punctuation.
Up to 30 minutes (Client Intake) and 5 hours (RM-Intake) stale data is accepted.
assumptions.if_wrong: Recent patients treated as new -> duplicate charts.

assumptions.statement: 'Inactive' = coverage terminated (Flag8 review); 'not eligible' = active but plan not accepted/no HH benefit (decline).
assumptions.reason: BRD does not define the difference.

assumptions.statement: When no payer portal check was done, the Kantime address comes from the referral portal.
Only Careport referral UI is in scope for this build.
Medicare bypass chart creation runs Kantime Check Duplicate and readmits an existing patient.
'Update CareFlo app' means writing status and decision to the CareFlo database.
Medicare PPS auto-acceptance is already covered by the Medicare rules in 5.1/5.10.
assumptions.reason: PPS section 12.9 not in v1.25 body.

assumptions.statement: 'Paediatric Plan (Purple)' must come from a column not present in Payor Mapping (r2). Until supplied, paediatric plan rules cannot run.
When Payor Portal lists two portals, try them in the listed order.
assumptions.reason: Master has combined values; BRD says 'Availity or Ability'.
